term: joint obtaining of a fixed collection of conditions
definition: JointTrue A S w means every fact f in the fixed Set S holds at w. JointContingent means this joint truth actually holds and fails at some world accessible from w, specializing the existing fact-level actual/accessible-absence modality to a conjunction predicate. No aggregate fact token or being is added to A. With a Groups record choose S = h.members g, including contributors and enablers.
note: Owner-proposed simplification on 2026-10-31. Logical conjunction packaging, not a new causal substance or an attributed historical claim. Exact meaning, examples, fixed-roster/alternative-cause distinctions, structural justification and open explanatory application: docs/notes/underived-essence-identity.md, joint-condition compression section.
